title: Ban Appeal - Refuse to SS

replies.author: Spoookeh
replies.body:
Hey Okiba,

I'll go through the set of events that led to your ban first and explain why the punishment was necessary. 

Firstly, it took you a good 7 minutes to download join.me when you entered teamspeak. From the videos it seems that your internet is perfectly fine and it doesn't take 7 minutes to download the program. For me this is extremely suspicious, were you deleting something? Trying to delay? How can we know?

Secondly, I really don't understand why your computer doesn't let you open 2 programs, both for screensharing when you've downloaded them with no problems. How do you use other programs? How do they open and not these? Again, we can't be sure.

Lastly we gave you a whole 25 minutes when usually we would ban after 5. For most mods it's a pretty obvious sign that you're trying to hide something.

As for the videos I'll get some others to take a look at them but they don't give any explanation as to why the programs aren't opening. From what I've seen your PC isn't slow so I really don't know what it is. Join.me is an especially simple program and takes me a minute to open even though I play on a £75 laptop...

If you could reply to some of the points made and try to explain them before I get some more opinions on the videos that would be great.

replies.author: Okiba
replies.body:
It took me like 20 seconds to download the programs, but the rest of the time was me trying to run them, delete them and redownload them, and running them again.

Not sure why my computer doesn't let me open 2 programs (probably some error in the code). I'm planning on doing a fresh install of windows soon so it will hopefully fix those problems.

Can't really say anything for the last point, only that I'm not hiding anything.

replies.author: Spoookeh
replies.body:
Well I appreciate the time you took for recording the videos. You clearly had a problem opening the problems and it was due to your computer.

I will get your ban appealed because there was nothing else you could have done. Yes people thought you were sketchy so I'll just add the point that if you were using anything, don't do it again.

Sorry for any inconvenience but I had to issue the ban with no evidence as to why the programs weren't opening. A fresh install would be very helpful because I've never seen a computer that can't handle join.me... Welcome back to the server :P

-Spoookeh
